empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create reusable review guidance, or import Markdown from pasted text or a local file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to configure it, preview the Markdown, or inspect its versions.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: Skills are reusable text configuration shared by review agents.
create.starterBody:
# {name}

Describe what the reviewer should check and when this guidance applies.
create.createFailed: The skill could not be created. Review the fields and try again.

drawer.title: Import a skill
drawer.subtitle: Paste Markdown or load a local text file, then review it before enabling it.
drawer.localOnly: Only local text is read. URL imports and the community catalog are not connected in this version, and imported skills start disabled.

import.fileHint: .md, .markdown, or .txt. The file is read in your browser and is not executed.
import.nameHint: Optional when the Markdown starts with a level-one heading.
import.bodyHint: Review this text carefully: an attached, enabled skill becomes part of an agent's instructions.
import.bodyPlaceholder:
# Review rule

Explain what to check…
import.readFailed: The selected file could not be read.
import.createFailed: The skill could not be imported. Review the fields and try again.

community.unavailable: Community search is unavailable because no catalog service is configured.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Explain when this skill should be attached

config.title: Configuration
config.bodyHint: This is the only skill text sent to an agent. Saving a changed body creates an immutable version.
config.deleteConfirm: Delete skill “{name}”? It will be removed from every agent that uses it.
config.mutationFailed: The skill change could not be saved. Try again.

preview.title: Markdown preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

evals.title: Evals are not available yet
evals.body: This tab is a deliberate scaffold. No eval cases are created or scored by the current Skills API.

stats.title: Skill statistics are not available yet
stats.body: DevDigest does not yet attribute findings or review outcomes to individual skills, so no usage metrics are shown here.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every saved configuration snapshot keeps the exact body used by that version.
versions.emptyBody: A version will appear after the skill is saved.
